request_text: During annual enrollment, employees struggle to compare health insurance plans because premiums, deductibles, coverage, and benefits are documented differently. HR needs a simpler comparison experience that reduces repetitive questions.
Regional sales managers combine separate Excel files every Monday to compare sales performance against targets. They need a trusted dashboard with consistent metrics and weekly refreshes.
Customers repeatedly contact support agents for order status, delivery dates, refunds, and returns. The service team wants self-service answers backed by current order data.
Finance manually extracts vendor invoice data from PDFs and scanned documents before entering it into the finance system. The team needs faster processing with field validation and exception review.
New employee onboarding activities span training, documentation, system access, and policy acknowledgements. HR and hiring managers need task ownership, due dates, and completion visibility.
Employees email travel expenses and receipts to Finance, which tracks approvals and pending reimbursements in a spreadsheet. Both groups need a clear submission and review workflow.
Marketing analysts manually combine campaign data from email, social media, and search platforms. Campaign managers need a cross-channel performance view with shared attribution definitions.
Facilities receives office issues about broken equipment, temperature problems, cleaning requirements, and meeting rooms through email and chat. Employees need one place to submit and track issues.
